basic_profile.bio: A tech enthusiast originally from Bahrain, currently living in the United States. I work as a freelance IT consultant, specializing in hardware upgrades and network solutions. My interests include gaming, leathercraft, and exploring new tech trends. I dislike misinformation and overly commercialized content. Typically online during late evenings and weekends. Single and enjoy traveling to tech conventions to keep up with the latest advancements.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Gained expertise through a combination of self-teaching, online courses, and hands-on experience working as a freelance IT consultant. Frequently consults tech forums and online communities to stay updated.
